name: Scroll of Mage Hand
description: A strip of vellum, one line of cramped script and a smell of cold hearths. Read it aloud and the hand is borrowed, once.
notes: A scroll of Mage Hand (mw-ju8.4), spell.mage-hand. Intended to cast that spell once when read and be consumed. That read-and-cast path does not exist yet (no spell content or cast pipeline: mw-e06.2), so for now it is a stock item with no effect and teaches nothing; a follow-up bead wires it. Base value 50 sits in the economy scroll band (40-150).
